data.name: Attaar
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Attaar means 'the giver'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'attar', which means 'to give'. In Islamic history, Attaar is the name of a Sufi saint who was known for his generosity and selflessness. He would give away his possessions to those in need, and was a source of inspiration and guidance for many.
data.spiritual_meaning: To serve and give, following the example of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
